description: This file is a Perl module implementing a wrapper around SVN::Ra for use within git-svn, providing enhanced caching, version compatibility, and additional functionality for handling Subversion repositories.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl module providing an object-oriented wrapper around SVN::Ra with additional caching, version compatibility handling, and git-svn specific functions.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SVN::Ra object for a given URL, ensuring canonicalization and caching.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Getter/setter for the repository URL, ensuring it remains canonicalized.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks if a path exists in the repository at a specific revision, with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries at a given path and revision, with caching and version compatibility handling.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Fetches commit logs for specified paths and revisions, wrapping the callback for path adjustments.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Compares two repository trees for differences, uses SVN::Client::diff, with compatibility considerations.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Creates a commit editor, considering SVN version differences.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an update operation with specific handling of paths and revisions.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Switches the working copy to a new URL and revision, handling reparenting as needed.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Computes the longest common directory path among a set of git-svn glob objects.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Loops fetching revisions for a set of git-svn glob objects, with support for partial fetches and error handling.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively retrieves directory entries up to a specified depth, used for glob matching.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Attempts to shorten the repository URL by trimming path components if they are not needed.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Detects if the current SVN setup supports switching to another URL.
